description: Measure one domain's open-web SEO authority from a periodic Common Crawl Web Graph snapshot (harmonic centrality weight 0.65, PageRank 0.35): returns domain_authority_score 0-100, authority_percentile and the graph release and crawl period. Not live data. Answers 404 domain_not_covered, uncharged, when the domain is not in the graph; costs $0.01 USDC.

domain.description: Domain or URL to measure, such as example.com.

name: get_domain_authority
